Calibration.Purpose: p_MA -10% / p_MS -1.4% offsets of the canonical four-edge coupon vs the graded_v2 reference are half p-convergence and half an h-limit of the metal edge/sidewall layer (6001: 6,423 tris at 0.113 um vs ~1.0M in the reference; physics-02). These variants refine that layer through EXISTING recipe parameters only.
Calibration.Decision: SUPERVISOR-DECISIONS.md items 22 (V1/V2, 2026-09-16), 27-29 (seeded transverse edge layer, 2026-09-16), 30 (required tetrahedra, seed-side gates, 2026-09-16) and 32 (1 nm x 50 nm layer with the layer-local quality rule, 2026-09-17)

MinimumAchievedAspect.Kind: anisotropy-DESIGN gate (checks metric intent, not mesh quality)
MinimumAchievedAspect.Reason: V1 halves the tangential size to the sidewall interior-row spacing (0.05), so TangentialP50 / max transverse P90 is ~1.0 by construction (production 0.0946 / 0.0500 = 1.89); every physical gate (MinimumScaledJacobian, MaximumCornerAspect, MaximumProtectedMeasureError, ownership closure, trace-diagonal, MaximumElements, MaximumSeconds, MaximumRSSGiB) keeps its production value
MinimumAchievedAspect.ProductionUse: FORBIDDEN: this gate value can never be used by the production suite; test_general_mesh_manifest asserts the production manifest keeps 1.5

EdgeLayerQualityRule.Kind: layer-local QUALITY gate rule (supervisor decision 32): inside the recorded edge layer (edge_volume_metric.EDGE_LAYER_CELL_RULE: a tetrahedron with a vertex within EdgeLayer.RequiredReach of a span) a cell is gated by positive orientation above the recorded roundoff floor and by longest edge / shortest height <= MaximumEdgeAspect instead of MinimumScaledJacobian; MinimumScaledJacobian, MaximumJacobianCondition and every other gate keep their production values on every cell outside the layer
EdgeLayerQualityRule.Reason: a layer tetrahedron of EdgeSize x lc_tangent has a scaled Jacobian of (EdgeSize / lc_tangent)^2 by construction (1 nm x 50 nm: 4e-4, measured 21,626 layer cells below 0.01 on the first 1 nm probe), so MinimumScaledJacobian 0.01 cannot judge the user-directed O(1 nm) transverse layer without nested tangential subdivision; the rule judges what matters for a positive, non-degenerate anisotropic layer cell (orientation and a bounded edge aspect) and reports the layer scaled Jacobian as a diagnostic
EdgeLayerQualityRule.Derivation: MaximumEdgeAspect = 2 x lc_tangent / EdgeSize = 2 x 0.05 / 0.001 = 100: the longest layer edge is the ridge-grid diagonal sqrt(2) x lc_tangent = 70.7 nm and the shortest height is the first slab EdgeSize = 1 nm (the row zigzag moves nodes outward), so the design aspect is sqrt(2) x 50 = 70.7 and the factor 2 leaves 1.41 for the zigzag (1.05) and the Delaunay split of the slabs; the roundoff floor 1e-12 on the scaled Jacobian marks a cell flat to double precision (the design minimum is 4e-4)
EdgeLayerQualityRule.Applies: every case of this manifest with a recorded EdgeLayer; the seed (--edge-layer-maximum-aspect on mesh_spatial_coupon.jl) and the label restorer (same option) of a case declaring Calibration.EdgeLayerQualityRule gate the layer with the same bound (verify_canonical_case_entries.validate_edge_layer_quality_rule_binding); the audit producer reports MeshQuality.EdgeLayer / MeshQuality.OutsideEdgeLayer and general_mesh_manifest.audit_manifest_evidence judges them (edge-layer-quality, mesh-quality-jacobian outside)
EdgeLayerQualityRule.ProductionUse: FORBIDDEN: a production manifest (no Calibration block) cannot carry Gates.EdgeLayerQualityRule and none of its cases may declare a Calibration or EdgeLayer block (general_mesh_manifest.validate_manifest fails preflight closed); test_general_mesh_manifest asserts it

Calibration.VariantParameters: the calibration recipe parameters live in the recorded stage commands (as in production) and are listed per case under Calibration
Calibration.Verification: per case only (verify_canonical_case_entries.py); the ScalingComparisons below are schema placeholders required by validate_manifest and are never evaluated as a matrix

EdgeLayerVariant.CommandBinding: verify_canonical_case_entries.py binds the declared seed/metric/adaptation options; mesh_stage_contract.validate_edge_layer binds EdgeSize/GrowthRatio/Aspect across the seed command, the metric command, the seed census, the recipe and the adapter hmin

EdgeLayerQualityRule.Rule: calibration only (decision 32): cells inside the recorded edge layer pass on positive orientation (scaled Jacobian > ScaledJacobianRoundoffFloor) and longest edge / shortest height <= MaximumEdgeAspect; all other gates apply outside the layer; see Calibration.GateDeviations.EdgeLayerQualityRule

Calibration.Decision: SUPERVISOR-DECISIONS.md items 27-30 (2026-09-16): NormalSize 0.025 is 25x too coarse for the edge-singular MA integrand (|E|^2 ~ r^-2/3); the seeded edge layer with EdgeSize as the recorded h-parameter (25 -> 4 -> 2 -> 1 nm) replaces the self-similar normal-size halving; at 1 nm / aspect 4 the layer measured 4,703,260 tets (layer 1.3M, surface-driven) with 1,955 cells below scaled Jacobian 0.02 in 1,522 repair components (probe root /tmp/edge-layer-work-20260916/seed-b), over the 4,000,000 cap and beyond the frozen restoration's repair budget, so 4 nm is built first; the first 4 nm build failed label restoration on an MMG corner outcome (semantic corner (0, 8, 0) at aspect 5.39, the fourth campaign blocked by MMG's corner output), so decision 30 makes the near-corner/near-edge region deterministic: the seed defines it and MMG keeps it verbatim

EdgeLayer.MetricLaw: hn(r) = min(FarSize, EdgeSize + (GrowthRatio - 1) min(r, Reach) + min(max(0, r - Reach), ProtectedDistance) + FarGrowth max(0, r - Reach - ProtectedDistance)); ht = min(band ht, Aspect hn) on the layer spans; EdgeSize/GrowthRatio/Aspect are bound between the seed command, the metric command, the seed census and the recipe by mesh_stage_contract.validate_edge_layer; adapter hmin = EdgeSize
EdgeLayer.ScaledJacobianArgument: a tetrahedron whose corner has three tangential edges of length ht and volume hn^2 ht / 6 has scaled Jacobian (hn/ht)^2; MinimumScaledJacobian 0.01 (repair target 0.02) therefore bounds the layer anisotropy to roughly 5; prisms would not have this limit (not pursued)
EdgeLayer.FarFieldPolicy: seed cells whose centroid lies within SurfaceProtectionRadius of a layer span are excluded from the far-field budget policy seed load (they are re-meshed to the recorded layer metric), so the far size stays 0.16 as on V2
EdgeLayer.RequiredTetrahedra: decision 30: seed tetrahedra with centroid within CornerIsotropyRadius of a semantic corner and seed tetrahedra with a vertex within LayerThickness x (1 + RowZigzag) + EdgeSize of a layer span are MMG required tetrahedra (metric stage artifact required-tetrahedra.txt bound as an adaptation input; adapter flag --required-tetrahedra; recipe RequiredTetrahedra record with per-corner/per-span counts); MMG keeps them verbatim (vertex order included), the restorer freezes their vertices, and the seed stage optimizes and gates the same region with the restorer's gate values (bounded coordinate descent: surface vertices in their planes, 0.75 x the local prescribed size)
EdgeLayer.CornerTaperOffset: rows start at the ridge grid outside the corner size law after the taper (CornerLawReach 0.137 + 1 x 0.05 = 0.187 um from a semantic corner); the isotropic corner balls stay at NormalSize (follow-up: 3D corner singularities remain under-resolved relative to the edges)

EdgeLayer.MetricLaw: hn(r) = min(FarSize, EdgeSize + (GrowthRatio - 1) min(r, Reach) + min(max(0, r - Reach), ProtectedDistance) + FarGrowth max(0, r - Reach - ProtectedDistance)); ht = min(band ht, Aspect hn) on the layer spans; EdgeSize/GrowthRatio/Aspect are bound between the seed command, the metric command, the seed census and the recipe by mesh_stage_contract.validate_edge_layer; adapter hmin = EdgeSize
EdgeLayer.ScaledJacobianArgument: a tetrahedron whose corner has three tangential edges of length ht and volume hn^2 ht / 6 has scaled Jacobian (hn/ht)^2 = (1/50)^2 = 4e-4 in the first slab; the layer is therefore judged by Gates.EdgeLayerQualityRule (orientation + edge aspect <= 100), not by MinimumScaledJacobian, which keeps gating every cell outside the layer
EdgeLayer.FarFieldPolicy: seed cells whose centroid lies within SurfaceProtectionRadius of a layer span are excluded from the far-field budget policy seed load (they are re-meshed to the recorded layer metric), so the far size stays 0.16 as on V2
EdgeLayer.RequiredTetrahedra: decision 30: seed tetrahedra with centroid within CornerIsotropyRadius of a semantic corner and seed tetrahedra with a vertex within LayerThickness x (1 + RowZigzag) + EdgeSize of a layer span are MMG required tetrahedra (metric stage artifact required-tetrahedra.txt bound as an adaptation input; adapter flag --required-tetrahedra; recipe RequiredTetrahedra record with per-corner/per-span counts); MMG keeps them verbatim (vertex order included), the restorer freezes their vertices, and the seed stage optimizes and gates the same region with the restorer's gate values (bounded coordinate descent: surface vertices in their planes, 0.75 x the local prescribed size)
EdgeLayer.CornerTaperOffset: no taper (TangentialSubdivision 1): rows start at the ridge grid outside the corner size law (CornerLawReach 0.137 um from a semantic corner); the isotropic corner balls stay at NormalSize
